purpose: Recognition, application alternatives and restraint controls from King forewords, memoir opening, communication demonstration, workshop/publishing context, postscript and reading-list review. Retrieval and fixture checks do not measure semantic judgment.

recognition.query: Two readers imagine a scene differently although its stated facts agree. A request asks for grounded alternative perspectives without adding scene facts.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Separate scene constraints from unspecified visualization; do not treat variation alone as error.

execution.draft: Supplied scene: A sealed envelope lies on a bench. It bears a red mark. Compare two sentence-level emphases without inventing facts.
execution.instruction: Compare two grounded emphases; identify shared constraints and unspecified details.
execution.reference_response: On the bench lies a sealed envelope with a red mark.
alternative_responses: The envelope bears a red mark and lies sealed on the bench.
criteria: The envelope is sealed.
It lies on a bench.
It bears a red mark.
No material, size, motive or observer is supplied.

non_application.draft: Supplied assembly instructions specify a 12-millimeter clearance; the dimension controls whether the part fits.
criteria: Preserve the exact supplied dimension rather than substitute an approximate scenic comparison.

cases.exception_anchor: Technical instructions can require exact measurements and materials.

recognition.query: A memoir revision replaces perhaps or I do not remember with a definite childhood motive. A writer wants a coherent recollection but lacks a continuous timeline.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from personal, historical or genre-dependent prescriptions.

execution.draft: Supplied memory: I remember a yellow room. My aunt says we moved there when I was five. I do not know why we moved. Draft: At five, I moved into the yellow room because my mother wanted a fresh start.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: I remember a yellow room. My aunt says we moved there when I was five; I do not know why.
alternative_responses: My aunt dates the move to when I was five. What I remember is the yellow room, not why we came to it.
criteria: The yellow room is remembered.
The age comes from the aunt's account.
The reason for the move is unknown.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Supplied record: A dated letter says why the family moved, and the user wants an attributed reconstruction.
criteria: Use the provided corroboration rather than insist every recovered fact must remain unknowable.

cases.exception_anchor: A fragmentary memoir can be intentional rather than a structural error.

recognition.query: A critique says the tone is off but identifies no words or effect. A workshop reaction is treated as a definite flaw without a recoverable reason.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from personal, historical or genre-dependent prescriptions.

execution.draft: Feedback: 'The scene feels wrong.' Request: Help me respond to the critique; do not change the scene.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: Ask which moment felt wrong and whether the issue was unclear action, a character choice that seemed unsupported, or simply a different tonal preference. The general reaction alone does not identify a correction.
alternative_responses: Ask the reader to quote the triggering sentence and describe what they expected next. Compare that expectation with the scene's intended effect.
criteria: Only a general reaction is supplied.
No passage-specific error has been established.
No rewrite is authorized.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Feedback quotes two incompatible dates for the same event and supplies the governing dated record.
criteria: Do not postpone an already located, supported inconsistency as though all criticism were vague taste.

cases.exception_anchor: A reader can honestly report a reaction without having a complete explanation.

recognition.query: A query letter claims a story was published when it was accepted but never appeared. A book's old postal template is treated as current submission policy. An editor wants a polished professional letter but has not supplied credentials.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from personal, historical or genre-dependent prescriptions.

execution.draft: Supplied facts: 'North Window' was accepted by a journal that closed before publication. Request: State that history accurately in a draft query.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: 'North Window' was accepted for publication, but the journal closed before it appeared.
alternative_responses: The journal accepted 'North Window'; its closure prevented the story's publication.
criteria: The story was accepted.
The journal closed before publication.
No publication, award or representation is established.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Current supplied guidelines ask for a synopsis, sample chapters and a particular online form.
criteria: Follow the actual guidelines rather than force the book's brief postal presentation.

cases.exception_anchor: The recipient can require more than a short cover letter.

recognition.query: A memoir scene makes the narrator know another person's reason before they learned it. A scene checker calls hindsight a contradiction even though it is clearly marked as learned later.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from personal, historical or genre-dependent prescriptions.

execution.draft: Supplied facts: I saw the driver beside the stalled van. A week later he told me he had been looking for a lost address. Draft: I saw him beside the van and knew he was looking for a lost address.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: I saw the driver beside the stalled van. A week later, he told me he had been looking for a lost address.
alternative_responses: When I saw the driver beside the stalled van, I did not yet have his explanation. A week later, he said he had been looking for a lost address.
criteria: The driver was seen beside the stalled van.
The explanation came a week later from the driver.
The explanation remains attributed, not independently confirmed.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Retrospective opening: I learned a week later why he had stopped. That afternoon, I only saw the van.
criteria: The time layers are already clear; do not call the framing inconsistent or force strict chronological narration.

cases.exception_anchor: A retrospective narrator may state later knowledge before describing the event if its frame is clear.

recognition.query: A writer is pressured to reproduce a famous author's painful return to work. A routine is presented as proof that writing will heal an injury. A user needs a lighter writing task under a stated time limit.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from personal, historical or genre-dependent prescriptions.

execution.draft: Request: I have ten minutes available today. Help me resume my essay without demanding a completed paragraph.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: Use the ten minutes to reread one passage and note the next question it needs to answer. Drafting can wait; the session does not need a word-count target.
alternative_responses: Spend the ten minutes listing two possible next sentences. Stop there, and compare them in a later session if you want to.
criteria: Only ten minutes are available.
No completed paragraph is required.
No medical outcome or productivity diagnosis is supplied.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Request: I have a working routine and enough time; outline a full revision session.
criteria: Do not impose reduced output or a recovery narrative when the user has not supplied that constraint.

cases.exception_anchor: The writer may freely choose a demanding session; it is not mandatory for legitimacy.

recognition.query: A booklist is mistaken for access to every book it names. A guide's favorite novels are treated as a universal canon or current recommendations.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from personal, historical or genre-dependent prescriptions.

execution.draft: Request: This guide names a novel. Tell me the exact technique used in its final paragraph; no paragraph or independently reviewed source is supplied.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: The list establishes that the guide's author valued the novel, not what its final paragraph does. Supply that paragraph or a source we can inspect before making a passage-specific claim.
alternative_responses: Use the list to choose a reading exercise, then inspect a supplied passage for syntax, perspective and pacing. Do not claim the listed novel's ending has already been analyzed.
criteria: Only the title's presence on a reading list is established.
No final paragraph is available.
No technique or current publication status is verified.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: The user supplies the final paragraph and asks for a bounded craft analysis.
criteria: Analyze the available passage rather than refuse merely because the full novel has not been read.

cases.exception_anchor: A listed work can be discussed from separately supplied and reviewed evidence.
